options.name: Garden rose cascade
options.label: Garden rose cascade
options.description: Loose garden roses, sweet peas and trailing jasmine spill over urns and arches. It looks picked that morning, not arranged.
palette_hint: Secret Garden: Blush, Rose, Sage
Cottage Rose: Cottage Pink, Hedgerow, Clotted Cream
Versailles Blush: Ballet Pink, Duck Egg, Gilt
Teacup Garden: Lace, Rose Tea, Pistachio
options.planner_tip: Ask your florist which garden roses open fully in your month so blooms peak on the day.

options.name: Dried pampas and palm
options.label: Dried pampas and palm
options.description: Bleached palm spears, pampas plumes and dried grasses in sand and rust tones. Holds its shape in dry heat and wind.

Palm and Hibiscus: Palm, Hibiscus, Mango
Fiesta Brights: Talavera Red, Marigold, Sol
options.planner_tip: Dried pieces can be made weeks early, which frees up the florist the week of.

options.name: Sculptural single stems
options.label: Sculptural single stems
options.description: One striking stem per vessel, like a calla or anthurium, set in clear glass or stone. Lots of open space around each bloom.

Steel and Brick: Brick, Steel, Loft Concrete
Gatsby Gold: Jet Black, Deco Gold, Deco Champagne
options.planner_tip: Fewer stems means each one is seen up close, so ask to approve the exact bloom.

options.name: Dark bloom drama
options.label: Dark bloom drama
options.description: Black dahlias, burgundy ranunculus and plum calla lilies against deep green leaves. Rich and moody, made for candlelight.

Midnight Ballroom: Midnight, Gold, Ivory
Harvest Bordeaux: Bordeaux, Barrel Oak, Harvest
Frost and Silver: Frost, Silver Birch, Icicle Blue
options.planner_tip: Dark flowers vanish in low light, so mix in a few cream blooms to catch the glow.

options.name: Wildflower meadow jars
options.label: Wildflower meadow jars
options.description: Cosmos, Queen Anne's lace and cornflower in mismatched glass jars down every table. Easy, cheerful and a little wild.

Manor Green: Hunter Green, Heather, Tweed
Retro Sorbet: Mint, Peach, Butter

options.name: Tropical leaf and orchid
options.label: Tropical leaf and orchid
options.description: Monstera, banana leaf and orchids layered with bright hibiscus and ginger flowers. Bold shapes that read well in full sun.

Talavera Blue: Cobalt, Tile White, Saffron
Fern House: Fern Green, Glass Mint, Ivory White

options.name: Evergreen and frosted branch
options.label: Evergreen and frosted branch
options.description: Fir, cedar and white ranunculus with frosted eucalyptus and bare birch branches. Smells like a winter forest.

Pine and Timber: Bark, Timber, Candlelight
Black and Gold Gala: Onyx, Gala White, Gilded

options.name: Citrus and olive branch
options.label: Citrus and olive branch
options.description: Potted lemon trees, silvery olive branches and loose white blooms set on stone ledges. Sunny and Mediterranean.

Rose Terrace: Rose Wine, Grape Leaf, Barrel
Sea Glass: Sea Glass, Mist, Shell

options.name: Lavender and herb bundles
options.label: Lavender and herb bundles

Meadow Tea: Elderflower, Foxglove, Sage Leaf
Harvest Field: Sunflower, Barn Red, Hay
Tuscan Cypress: Cypress, Sienna, Travertine

options.name: Ikebana-inspired branches

Sapphire Jazz: Sapphire, Platinum, Gold Foil
